submission.description: Configure how form submissions are handled.
submission.auto_save_help: Saves form progress, allowing respondents to resume later.
submission.payment_auto_save_notice: Must be enabled with a payment block.
submission.update_record_help: When matching values are found in the selected column(s), the (first) existing record will be updated instead of creating a new record. If there's no match, a new record will be created.
submission.clear_empty_fields_help: When enabled, fields left empty in submission will clear existing values in Submission. When disabled, only filled fields are updated.
submission.advanced_description: Configure advanced options for form submissions and data collection.

submission.partial_submissions_pro_description: Capture valuable data from incomplete form submissions. Analyze where users drop off and collect partial information even when they don't complete the entire form.
submission.ip_tracking_help: Collect and store submitter IP addresses for analytics, fraud prevention, and geographic insights. Helps identify submission patterns and improve security.
submission.ip_tracking_pro_description: Automatically capture submitter IP addresses to gain valuable insights into your form traffic. Analyze geographic patterns, detect suspicious activity, and enhance your form security with detailed submission analytics.
submission.gdpr_description: Ensure your privacy policy discloses IP address collection and obtain proper user consent where required.
submission.after_submission_pro_description: Customize post-submission behavior: redirect users, show custom messages, or trigger actions. Upgrade to unlock advanced options for a seamless user experience. We have plenty of other pro features to enhance your form functionality and user engagement.
submission.after_submission_description: Customize the user experience after form submission.
submission.re_fillable_help: Allows user to fill the form multiple times
submission.editable_pro_description: On the Free plan, you can try out all paid features only within the form editor. Upgrade your plan to allow users to update their submissions via a unique URL, and much more. Gain full access to all advanced features.
